01_monthly_churn.title: Monthly logo and MRR churn, Feb-Oct 2026
01_monthly_churn.description: Churn rate = subscriptions canceled in the month / subscriptions active on the 1st of the month. MRR churn uses the same denominator weighted by MRR.
01_monthly_churn.sql:
-- title: Monthly logo and MRR churn, Feb-Oct 2026
-- description: Churn rate = subscriptions canceled in the month / subscriptions active on the 1st of the month. MRR churn uses the same denominator weighted by MRR.
WITH months(m) AS (
  VALUES ('2026-02'),('2026-03'),('2026-04'),('2026-05'),('2026-06'),
         ('2026-07'),('2026-08'),('2026-09'),('2026-10')
),
grid AS (
  SELECT m.m AS month, s.*,
         (s.started_at <= m.m || '-01' AND (s.canceled_at IS NULL OR s.canceled_at >= m.m || '-01')) AS active_start,
         (substr(s.canceled_at, 1, 7) = m.m) AS canceled_in_month
  FROM months m CROSS JOIN subscriptions s
)
SELECT month,
       SUM(active_start)                                                   AS active_start,
       SUM(canceled_in_month)                                              AS cancellations,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(canceled_in_month) / SUM(active_start), 2)        AS logo_churn_pct,
       SUM(CASE WHEN active_start THEN mrr_cents END) / 100                AS mrr_start_usd,
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN canceled_in_month THEN mrr_cents END), 0) / 100 AS lost_mrr_usd,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN canceled_in_month THEN mrr_cents END), 0)
             / SUM(CASE WHEN active_start THEN mrr_cents END), 2)          AS mrr_churn_pct,
       SUM(substr(started_at, 1, 7) = month)                               AS new_subscriptions
FROM grid
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

02_headline.title: Headline: September vs August and vs the Mar-Aug baseline
02_headline.description: Baseline is the pooled Mar-Aug rate (total cancellations / total active-at-start subscription-months).
02_headline.sql:
-- title: Headline: September vs August and vs the Mar-Aug baseline
-- description: Baseline is the pooled Mar-Aug rate (total cancellations / total active-at-start subscription-months).
WITH months(m) AS (
  VALUES ('2026-03'),('2026-04'),('2026-05'),('2026-06'),('2026-07'),('2026-08'),('2026-09'),('2026-10')
),
grid AS (
  SELECT m.m AS month,
         CASE WHEN m.m BETWEEN '2026-03' AND '2026-08' THEN 'baseline_mar_aug' ELSE m.m END AS period,
         s.mrr_cents,
         (s.started_at <= m.m || '-01' AND (s.canceled_at IS NULL OR s.canceled_at >= m.m || '-01')) AS active_start,
         (substr(s.canceled_at, 1, 7) = m.m) AS canceled_in_month
  FROM months m CROSS JOIN subscriptions s
)
SELECT period,
       SUM(active_start)                                             AS active_sub_months,
       SUM(canceled_in_month)                                        AS cancellations,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(canceled_in_month) / SUM(active_start), 2)  AS logo_churn_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN canceled_in_month THEN mrr_cents END), 0)
             / SUM(CASE WHEN active_start THEN mrr_cents END), 2)    AS mrr_churn_pct
FROM grid
WHERE month IN ('2026-03','2026-04','2026-05','2026-06','2026-07','2026-08','2026-09','2026-10')
GROUP BY period
UNION ALL
SELECT '2026-08', SUM(active_start), SUM(canceled_in_month),
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(canceled_in_month) / SUM(active_start), 2),
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN canceled_in_month THEN mrr_cents END), 0)
             / SUM(CASE WHEN active_start THEN mrr_cents END), 2)
FROM grid WHERE month = '2026-08'
ORDER BY period;

03_segment_churn.title: Churn rate by segment and month (region, plan, channel, payment method)
03_segment_churn.description: One row per dimension x segment x month. Payment method is the account's invoice payment method (each account uses exactly one).
03_segment_churn.sql:
-- title: Churn rate by segment and month (region, plan, channel, payment method)
-- description: One row per dimension x segment x month. Payment method is the account's invoice payment method (each account uses exactly one).
WITH months(m) AS (
  VALUES ('2026-03'),('2026-04'),('2026-05'),('2026-06'),('2026-07'),('2026-08'),('2026-09'),('2026-10')
),
pm AS (SELECT account_id, MAX(payment_method) AS payment_method FROM invoices GROUP BY account_id),
subs AS (
  SELECT s.*, a.region, a.acquisition_channel, pm.payment_method
  FROM subscriptions s
  JOIN accounts a ON a.id = s.account_id
  JOIN pm ON pm.account_id = s.account_id
),
long AS (
  SELECT 'region' AS dimension, region AS segment, * FROM subs
  UNION ALL SELECT 'plan', plan, * FROM subs
  UNION ALL SELECT 'channel', acquisition_channel, * FROM subs
  UNION ALL SELECT 'payment_method', payment_method, * FROM subs
),
grid AS (
  SELECT m.m AS month, l.dimension, l.segment, l.mrr_cents,
         (l.started_at <= m.m || '-01' AND (l.canceled_at IS NULL OR l.canceled_at >= m.m || '-01')) AS active_start,
         (substr(l.canceled_at, 1, 7) = m.m) AS canceled_in_month
  FROM months m CROSS JOIN long l
)
SELECT dimension, segment, month,
       SUM(active_start)                                                AS active_start,
       SUM(canceled_in_month)                                           AS cancellations,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(canceled_in_month) / SUM(active_start), 2)     AS logo_churn_pct,
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN canceled_in_month THEN mrr_cents END), 0) / 100 AS lost_mrr_usd
FROM grid
GROUP BY dimension, segment, month
ORDER BY dimension, segment, month;

04_cancel_reasons.title: Cancellations and lost MRR by cancel reason and month
04_cancel_reasons.description: Every cancellation in the snapshot, grouped by the recorded cancel_reason.
04_cancel_reasons.sql:
-- title: Cancellations and lost MRR by cancel reason and month
-- description: Every cancellation in the snapshot, grouped by the recorded cancel_reason.
SELECT substr(canceled_at, 1, 7)  AS month,
       cancel_reason,
       COUNT(*)                   AS cancellations,
       SUM(mrr_cents) / 100       AS lost_mrr_usd
FROM subscriptions
WHERE canceled_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY month, cancel_reason
ORDER BY month, cancel_reason;

05_region_x_payment.title: Churn by region x payment method and month (the interaction)
05_region_x_payment.description: Isolates the cell touched by release 4.7.0 (EU + card) and its natural controls (EU + invoice, non-EU + card).
05_region_x_payment.sql:
-- title: Churn by region x payment method and month (the interaction)
-- description: Isolates the cell touched by release 4.7.0 (EU + card) and its natural controls (EU + invoice, non-EU + card).
WITH months(m) AS (
  VALUES ('2026-03'),('2026-04'),('2026-05'),('2026-06'),('2026-07'),('2026-08'),('2026-09'),('2026-10')
),
pm AS (SELECT account_id, MAX(payment_method) AS payment_method FROM invoices GROUP BY account_id),
grid AS (
  SELECT m.m AS month, a.region, pm.payment_method, s.mrr_cents,
         (s.started_at <= m.m || '-01' AND (s.canceled_at IS NULL OR s.canceled_at >= m.m || '-01')) AS active_start,
         (substr(s.canceled_at, 1, 7) = m.m) AS canceled_in_month
  FROM months m CROSS JOIN subscriptions s
  JOIN accounts a ON a.id = s.account_id
  JOIN pm ON pm.account_id = s.account_id
)
SELECT region, payment_method, month,
       SUM(active_start)                                             AS active_start,
       SUM(canceled_in_month)                                        AS cancellations,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(canceled_in_month) / SUM(active_start), 2)  AS logo_churn_pct,
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN canceled_in_month THEN mrr_cents END), 0) / 100 AS lost_mrr_usd
FROM grid
GROUP BY region, payment_method, month
ORDER BY region, payment_method, month;

06_invoice_collection.title: Invoice collection by period, region and payment method
06_invoice_collection.description: Share of invoices that ended uncollectible, and average payment attempts. This is the mechanism check for the PSP migration.
06_invoice_collection.sql:
-- title: Invoice collection by period, region and payment method
-- description: Share of invoices that ended uncollectible, and average payment attempts. This is the mechanism check for the PSP migration.
SELECT i.period,
       a.region,
       i.payment_method,
       COUNT(*)                                                     AS invoices,
       SUM(i.status = 'uncollectible')                              AS uncollectible,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(i.status = 'uncollectible') / COUNT(*), 2) AS uncollectible_pct,
       ROUND(AVG(i.attempts), 2)                                    AS avg_attempts,
       SUM(i.attempts > 1)                                          AS invoices_needing_retry
FROM invoices i
JOIN accounts a ON a.id = i.account_id
GROUP BY i.period, a.region, i.payment_method
ORDER BY i.period, a.region, i.payment_method;

07_support_tickets.title: Support tickets by subject and month, with EU share
07_support_tickets.description: Ticket volume and average sentiment per subject. eu_tickets counts tickets from EU accounts.
07_support_tickets.sql:
-- title: Support tickets by subject and month, with EU share
-- description: Ticket volume and average sentiment per subject. eu_tickets counts tickets from EU accounts.
SELECT substr(t.created_at, 1, 7)    AS month,
       t.category,
       t.subject,
       COUNT(*)                      AS tickets,
       SUM(a.region = 'EU')          AS eu_tickets,
       ROUND(AVG(t.sentiment), 2)    AS avg_sentiment
FROM support_tickets t
JOIN accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id
GROUP BY month, t.category, t.subject
ORDER BY month, t.category, t.subject;

08_daily_cancellations.title: Daily cancellations, Jul-Oct 2026, split EU-card payment failures vs everything else
08_daily_cancellations.description: Used to line the spike up against release dates (4.7.0 on 2026-08-18, 4.8.0 on 2026-09-09).
08_daily_cancellations.sql:
-- title: Daily cancellations, Jul-Oct 2026, split EU-card payment failures vs everything else
-- description: Used to line the spike up against release dates (4.7.0 on 2026-08-18, 4.8.0 on 2026-09-09).
WITH pm AS (SELECT account_id, MAX(payment_method) AS payment_method FROM invoices GROUP BY account_id)
SELECT s.canceled_at AS day,
       SUM(a.region = 'EU' AND pm.payment_method = 'card' AND s.cancel_reason = 'payment_failed')        AS eu_card_payment_failed,
       SUM(NOT (a.region = 'EU' AND pm.payment_method = 'card' AND s.cancel_reason = 'payment_failed'))  AS all_other
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN accounts a ON a.id = s.account_id
JOIN pm ON pm.account_id = s.account_id
WHERE s.canceled_at BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-10-31'
GROUP BY s.canceled_at
ORDER BY s.canceled_at;

09_dunning_day_of_month.title: Day of month of payment_failed cancellations (dunning window)
09_dunning_day_of_month.description: Tests whether the spike starting 2026-09-09 is tied to release 4.8.0 (same day) or to the normal dunning cycle.
09_dunning_day_of_month.sql:
-- title: Day of month of payment_failed cancellations (dunning window)
-- description: Tests whether the spike starting 2026-09-09 is tied to release 4.8.0 (same day) or to the normal dunning cycle.
SELECT CASE WHEN canceled_at < '2026-09-01' THEN 'Feb-Aug' ELSE substr(canceled_at, 1, 7) END AS period,
       CAST(substr(canceled_at, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) AS day_of_month,
       COUNT(*) AS payment_failed_cancellations
FROM subscriptions
WHERE cancel_reason = 'payment_failed'
GROUP BY period, day_of_month
ORDER BY period, day_of_month;

10_did_groups.title: Difference-in-differences: EU-card vs control groups, pre (Jun-Aug) vs post (Sep-Oct)
10_did_groups.description: Monthly churn rate pooled over each window (cancellations / active-at-start subscription-months).
10_did_groups.sql:
-- title: Difference-in-differences: EU-card vs control groups, pre (Jun-Aug) vs post (Sep-Oct)
-- description: Monthly churn rate pooled over each window (cancellations / active-at-start subscription-months).
WITH months(m) AS (VALUES ('2026-06'),('2026-07'),('2026-08'),('2026-09'),('2026-10')),
pm AS (SELECT account_id, MAX(payment_method) AS payment_method FROM invoices GROUP BY account_id),
grid AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN m.m <= '2026-08' THEN 'pre_jun_aug' ELSE 'post_sep_oct' END AS window,
         CASE WHEN a.region = 'EU' THEN 'EU' ELSE 'non-EU' END || ' / ' || pm.payment_method AS grp,
         (s.started_at <= m.m || '-01' AND (s.canceled_at IS NULL OR s.canceled_at >= m.m || '-01')) AS active_start,
         (substr(s.canceled_at, 1, 7) = m.m) AS canceled_in_month
  FROM months m CROSS JOIN subscriptions s
  JOIN accounts a ON a.id = s.account_id
  JOIN pm ON pm.account_id = s.account_id
)
SELECT grp, window,
       SUM(active_start)                                             AS active_sub_months,
       SUM(canceled_in_month)                                        AS cancellations,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(canceled_in_month) / SUM(active_start), 2)  AS logo_churn_pct
FROM grid
GROUP BY grp, window
ORDER BY grp, window DESC;

11_team_price_change.title: Team plan price change test (4.8.0: $99 -> $129 for new signups only)
11_team_price_change.description: Compares Team subscribers on the old vs new price, and tracks too_expensive cancellations and "Price went up?" tickets.
11_team_price_change.sql:
-- title: Team plan price change test (4.8.0: $99 -> $129 for new signups only)
-- description: Compares Team subscribers on the old vs new price, and tracks too_expensive cancellations and "Price went up?" tickets.
SELECT 'team_cohort' AS view,
       CASE WHEN mrr_cents = 12900 THEN '$129 (new signups from 2026-09-09)' ELSE '$99 (existing)' END AS segment,
       COUNT(*)                              AS subscriptions,
       SUM(canceled_at >= '2026-09-01')      AS canceled_sep_oct,
       SUM(cancel_reason = 'too_expensive' AND canceled_at >= '2026-09-01') AS too_expensive_sep_oct
FROM subscriptions
WHERE plan = 'team'
GROUP BY segment
UNION ALL
SELECT 'too_expensive_by_month', substr(canceled_at, 1, 7), COUNT(*), NULL, NULL
FROM subscriptions
WHERE cancel_reason = 'too_expensive'
GROUP BY substr(canceled_at, 1, 7)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'price_tickets_by_month', substr(created_at, 1, 7), COUNT(*), NULL, NULL
FROM support_tickets
WHERE subject = 'Price went up?'
GROUP BY substr(created_at, 1, 7)
ORDER BY 1, 2;

12_usage_before_cancel.title: Product engagement of September-October churners before they canceled
12_usage_before_cancel.description: Seat utilization (weekly active users / seats) in the 8 weeks before cancellation vs the 8 weeks before that. usage_daily covers a 25% sample of accounts, so n is small.
12_usage_before_cancel.sql:
-- title: Product engagement of September-October churners before they canceled
-- description: Seat utilization (weekly active users / seats) in the 8 weeks before cancellation vs the 8 weeks before that. usage_daily covers a 25% sample of accounts, so n is small.
WITH pm AS (SELECT account_id, MAX(payment_method) AS payment_method FROM invoices GROUP BY account_id),
churners AS (
  SELECT s.account_id, s.canceled_at, a.seats,
         CASE WHEN a.region = 'EU' AND pm.payment_method = 'card' AND s.cancel_reason = 'payment_failed'
              THEN 'EU card, payment_failed' ELSE 'All other churners' END AS grp
  FROM subscriptions s
  JOIN accounts a ON a.id = s.account_id
  JOIN pm ON pm.account_id = s.account_id
  WHERE s.canceled_at >= '2026-09-01'
),
per_account AS (
  SELECT c.grp, c.account_id,
         AVG(CASE WHEN u.day BETWEEN date(c.canceled_at, '-56 days') AND date(c.canceled_at, '-1 day')
                  THEN 1.0 * u.active_users / c.seats END)  AS util_last_8w,
         AVG(CASE WHEN u.day BETWEEN date(c.canceled_at, '-112 days') AND date(c.canceled_at, '-57 days')
                  THEN 1.0 * u.active_users / c.seats END)  AS util_prior_8w
  FROM churners c
  JOIN usage_daily u ON u.account_id = c.account_id
  GROUP BY c.grp, c.account_id
)
SELECT grp,
       COUNT(*)                              AS sampled_accounts,
       ROUND(100 * AVG(util_prior_8w), 1)    AS seat_util_pct_prior_8w,
       ROUND(100 * AVG(util_last_8w), 1)     AS seat_util_pct_last_8w
FROM per_account
GROUP BY grp
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Retained accounts (Aug-Oct)',
       COUNT(DISTINCT u.account_id), NULL,
       ROUND(100 * AVG(1.0 * u.active_users / a.seats), 1)
FROM usage_daily u
JOIN accounts a ON a.id = u.account_id
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.account_id = u.account_id
WHERE s.canceled_at IS NULL AND u.day >= '2026-08-01';

13_revenue_impact.title: Revenue impact of the EU card payment failures
13_revenue_impact.description: Excess = actual EU-card lost MRR minus expected lost MRR at the segment's own Mar-Aug MRR churn rate. Also reports EU-card MRR still exposed.
13_revenue_impact.sql:
-- title: Revenue impact of the EU card payment failures
-- description: Excess = actual EU-card lost MRR minus expected lost MRR at the segment's own Mar-Aug MRR churn rate. Also reports EU-card MRR still exposed.
WITH months(m) AS (
  VALUES ('2026-03'),('2026-04'),('2026-05'),('2026-06'),('2026-07'),('2026-08'),('2026-09'),('2026-10')
),
pm AS (SELECT account_id, MAX(payment_method) AS payment_method FROM invoices GROUP BY account_id),
eu_card AS (
  SELECT s.* FROM subscriptions s
  JOIN accounts a ON a.id = s.account_id
  JOIN pm ON pm.account_id = s.account_id
  WHERE a.region = 'EU' AND pm.payment_method = 'card'
),
grid AS (
  SELECT m.m AS month, e.mrr_cents,
         (e.started_at <= m.m || '-01' AND (e.canceled_at IS NULL OR e.canceled_at >= m.m || '-01')) AS active_start,
         (substr(e.canceled_at, 1, 7) = m.m) AS canceled_in_month
  FROM months m CROSS JOIN eu_card e
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT month,
         SUM(active_start) AS active_start,
         SUM(canceled_in_month) AS cancellations,
         SUM(CASE WHEN active_start THEN mrr_cents END) / 100.0 AS mrr_start,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN canceled_in_month THEN mrr_cents END), 0) / 100.0 AS lost_mrr
  FROM grid GROUP BY month
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT 1.0 * SUM(cancellations) / SUM(active_start) AS logo_rate,
         SUM(lost_mrr) / SUM(mrr_start)               AS mrr_rate
  FROM monthly WHERE month BETWEEN '2026-03' AND '2026-08'
)
SELECT m.month,
       m.active_start,
       m.cancellations,
       ROUND(m.active_start * b.logo_rate, 1)                 AS expected_cancellations,
       ROUND(m.cancellations - m.active_start * b.logo_rate)  AS excess_cancellations,
       ROUND(m.lost_mrr)                                      AS lost_mrr_usd,
       ROUND(m.mrr_start * b.mrr_rate)                        AS expected_lost_mrr_usd,
       ROUND(m.lost_mrr - m.mrr_start * b.mrr_rate)           AS excess_lost_mrr_usd,
       ROUND(100 * b.logo_rate, 2)                            AS baseline_logo_churn_pct,
       ROUND(100 * b.mrr_rate, 2)                             AS baseline_mrr_churn_pct,
       (SELECT SUM(mrr_cents) / 100 FROM eu_card WHERE canceled_at IS NULL)  AS eu_card_mrr_still_active_usd,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eu_card WHERE canceled_at IS NULL)              AS eu_card_subs_still_active,
       (SELECT SUM(mrr_cents) / 100 FROM subscriptions WHERE canceled_at IS NULL) AS total_mrr_active_usd
FROM monthly m CROSS JOIN baseline b
WHERE m.month IN ('2026-09', '2026-10')
ORDER BY m.month;

14_ticket_churn_link.title: Did billing tickets after the PSP migration precede churn?
14_ticket_churn_link.description: Subscriptions active on 2026-09-01, split by whether the account filed a billing ticket on/after 2026-08-18, and the share that canceled in Sep-Oct.
14_ticket_churn_link.sql:
-- title: Did billing tickets after the PSP migration precede churn?
-- description: Subscriptions active on 2026-09-01, split by whether the account filed a billing ticket on/after 2026-08-18, and the share that canceled in Sep-Oct.
WITH pm AS (SELECT account_id, MAX(payment_method) AS payment_method FROM invoices GROUP BY account_id),
ticketed AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM support_tickets
  WHERE category = 'billing' AND created_at >= '2026-08-18'
)
SELECT CASE WHEN a.region = 'EU' AND pm.payment_method = 'card' THEN 'EU / card' ELSE 'All other' END AS grp,
       CASE WHEN t.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'billing ticket since 08-18' ELSE 'no billing ticket' END AS ticket_status,
       COUNT(*)                                                        AS subs_active_sep1,
       SUM(s.canceled_at IS NOT NULL)                                  AS canceled_sep_oct,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.canceled_at IS NOT NULL) / COUNT(*), 1)     AS canceled_pct
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN accounts a ON a.id = s.account_id
JOIN pm ON pm.account_id = s.account_id
LEFT JOIN ticketed t ON t.account_id = s.account_id
WHERE s.started_at <= '2026-09-01' AND (s.canceled_at IS NULL OR s.canceled_at >= '2026-09-01')
GROUP BY grp, ticket_status
ORDER BY grp, ticket_status;

15_cancellation_detail.title: Account-level cancellations, Aug-Oct 2026
15_cancellation_detail.description: Every cancellation since 2026-08-01 with its segment attributes and the payment attempts on its final invoice.
15_cancellation_detail.sql:
-- title: Account-level cancellations, Aug-Oct 2026
-- description: Every cancellation since 2026-08-01 with its segment attributes and the payment attempts on its final invoice.
WITH pm AS (SELECT account_id, MAX(payment_method) AS payment_method FROM invoices GROUP BY account_id)
SELECT s.account_id,
       a.region,
       s.plan,
       a.acquisition_channel                AS channel,
       pm.payment_method,
       s.cancel_reason,
       s.canceled_at,
       s.mrr_cents / 100                    AS mrr_usd,
       a.seats,
       (SELECT i.status   FROM invoices i WHERE i.account_id = s.account_id ORDER BY i.period DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_invoice_status,
       (SELECT i.attempts FROM invoices i WHERE i.account_id = s.account_id ORDER BY i.period DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_invoice_attempts
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN accounts a ON a.id = s.account_id
JOIN pm ON pm.account_id = s.account_id
WHERE s.canceled_at >= '2026-08-01'
ORDER BY s.canceled_at, s.account_id;

16_plan_x_eu_card.title: September churn by plan, split EU + card vs everyone else
16_plan_x_eu_card.description: Checks whether the Team (or any plan) increase is a pricing effect or the EU card payment failure showing up inside the plan.
16_plan_x_eu_card.sql:
-- title: September churn by plan, split EU + card vs everyone else
-- description: Checks whether the Team (or any plan) increase is a pricing effect or the EU card payment failure showing up inside the plan.
WITH pm AS (SELECT account_id, MAX(payment_method) AS payment_method FROM invoices GROUP BY account_id)
SELECT s.plan,
       CASE WHEN a.region = 'EU' AND pm.payment_method = 'card' THEN 'EU / card' ELSE 'All other' END AS grp,
       SUM(s.started_at <= '2026-09-01' AND (s.canceled_at IS NULL OR s.canceled_at >= '2026-09-01')) AS active_sep1,
       SUM(substr(s.canceled_at, 1, 7) = '2026-09')                                                   AS sep_cancellations,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(substr(s.canceled_at, 1, 7) = '2026-09')
             / SUM(s.started_at <= '2026-09-01' AND (s.canceled_at IS NULL OR s.canceled_at >= '2026-09-01')), 2) AS sep_churn_pct
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN accounts a ON a.id = s.account_id
JOIN pm ON pm.account_id = s.account_id
GROUP BY s.plan, grp
ORDER BY s.plan, grp;

significance.method: Two-proportion z-tests on monthly logo churn (pooled Mar-Aug baseline); Wilson 95% intervals; difference-in-differences on pooled Jun-Aug vs Sep-Oct rates from query 10.
